headboard: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 2 is the desired painted bed design/style, NOT perspective to copy. Paint onto image 1 to produce a finished FRONT ALBEDO TEXTURE for this exact headboard. Central panel is warm muted honey-walnut wood with broad soft brush strokes, a small ivory feather angled gently up-right and two tiny leafy sprigs centered in the upper central half, and subtle wood join lines in the lower half. Dark brown outline band becomes a gently highlighted rounded honey-wood carved border with quiet edge wear; do not add geometry, posts, pillows or furniture. Keep feather entirely inside center panel and well below top trim. Fill all canvas including outside outline with matching plain warm wood so UV borders have safe padding. Flat orthographic front surface texture: no perspective, no glossy highlights, no cast shadows, no bevel that changes outline. Soft broad storybook paint with designed value shapes and restrained grain, not noisy wood photo and not pixelated. The exact mesh silhouette and border placement of guide 1 must remain unchanged. No text, no grid, no watermark. Opaque RGB artwork.
